protocol.status: prospective; no final parameters or fields drawn

physical_reference.output_times: all 51 original output times from 0 to 0.25
physical_reference.comparison_domain: reference fields restricted by exact nodal inclusion to the 31^3 interior coarse nodes
physical_reference.normalization: fixed supplied initial-field Euclidean norm on the common coarse nodes
physical_reference.interpretation: empirical refinement checks; no rigorous continuum certificate. If either budget fails, report the discrepancy and retain the main result as same-grid evidence.
physical_reference.retention: all requested restricted fields; all Newton iterations and residuals; full native previous/current fields for the largest recorded step residual per case/level; full native initial/final fields on time-refinement cases. Full fine trajectories may be streamed, never silently omitted from a claimed full-field audit.

protocol.freeze_requirement: all model checkpoints, complete operator recipes, correction directions/POD basis, solver configuration and row-selection rule committed and hashed before parameter-seed access
